text: Quantum computers will one day forge the signatures that guard every crypto wallet today. Magen is a wallet built for that day. Get it for iPhone, or as a Chrome extension.
Install it on the iPhone, and open it.
Create a wallet. Pick a name. Then twelve words: your one backup. They stay hidden until you choose to see them.
Those twelve words make your address on Bitcoin, Zcash, Ethereum, Solana and more, plus a quantum safe key, M L D S A sixty five.
Creating the account is one transaction. Review it, and approve.
Your wallet is live on Near testnet, with two locks: your classical key, and the quantum safe one.
Receive on any chain. Here is Near, and here is Bitcoin, each with its own Q R code.
Now send half a Near. The approval sheet shows everything, and it is signed twice: classical, and quantum safe.
On the explorer, the signer key is the quantum safe one, and the wallet contract logged both signatures as verified.
Swap one Near for U S D T on Ref Finance. Four calls, one approval, two signatures.
Ref paid out one point two four U S D T.
Bring Bitcoin in. This is the wallet's own Bitcoin deposit address, made on chain by the bridge.
A new wallet starts empty. So here is our demo wallet, with two real deposits, each minted as n B T C on Near.
The mint on Near, and the Bitcoin payment it came from, sent earlier from a testnet wallet.
Zcash works the same way. A testnet deposit became n Z E C on Near.
Bridge out, to this wallet's own Solana address, through the Omni bridge. Same approval, same two signatures.
The bridge relays it. About a minute later, it has arrived on Solana.
Signed on NEAR testnet, then delivered on Solana devnet.
Private send. The money goes to a one time account only the recipient can open. Signed twice, like everything else.
Add guardians. Two of three can help you recover the wallet, and none of them can ever spend.
The guardians are saved on chain, and Near checked both signatures.
And the Q Day switch. One transaction makes your quantum safe key a native Near key. Same account, same balance.
The account on NEAR now lists an M L D S A key.
Activity keeps every move, each one linked to the explorer.
And Magen locks itself, behind Face I D.
One seed. Every chain. A quantum safe lock on every move. That's Magen.
